newsitem.title: UK: Ivorian coffee marketing report seen delayed.
newsitem.headline: Ivorian coffee marketing report seen delayed.

text.p: British firm Landell Mills Consultants (LMC) Ltd is in the process of completing a report on Ivorian coffee marketing, LMC sources said on Friday.
The report will look at further improvements on the country's internal and extenal marketing liberalisation, the sources said.
Sources in Ivory Coast had said in January the study was due to be completed by January 31.
The donor-sponsored study by LMC would also seek to avoid pitfalls seen in countries such as Cameroon where unfettered liberalisation led to coffee quality problems and loss of premium.

Ivory Coast embarked on a series of coffee and cocoa sector reforms in 1995 as conditions for a three-tranche $150 million World Bank Agricultural Sector Adjustment Loan. -- Clelia Oziel, London newsroom +44 171 542 4985
